Separate housing panels, sample interfaces and maintenance parts are visual schematic reconstructions; laser optics, fluidics tubing and carrier geometry do not implement a device protocol.
Doors/loaders have local origin and independent joint empties. Motion demonstrations validate scene articulation only; real hardware interlocks, firmware API and adapter protocols untested.
Outward-opening door axis corrected to -Z, with local door-centre probe and asset-front [0,-1,0] direction checks. Digital ranges are estimated and not calibrated to real hardware.
Fluidic reservoirs remain fixed on cabinet frame when doors open; no unsupported door-mounted bottle assumption.
